messages:
Maya: Async mid-Q OKR lane check — please reply with: shipped / slipped / canary + one-line next action. Need owners and cross-team blockers by EOD PDT.

Maya: Quick tracker snapshot (fill inline):
```
1) Dedicated autoscaler (owner: Oliver) — target: EOW — STATUS: ????
2) PKI + key rotation tooling (owner: Sanjay) — target: mid-Q — STATUS: ????
3) Embedding prefix cache (owner: Rachel/Product) — target: mid-Q — STATUS: ????
4) Runtime v2 canary (owner: Oliver) — target: mid-Q — STATUS: ????
5) Cost optimizer rules (owner: Maya) — target: EOW — STATUS: ????
```

Oliver: Autoscaler -> slipped. Root cause: scale-up throttling + delayed pod init left request queues long; in some mixes we also hit OOMs during scale events. Repro in ticket with load script and logs. Next: patch init/eviction heuristics, add backpressure handling in controller, and a CI stress e2e. ETA: ~72h for patch + 24h for canary.

Sanjay: PKI shipped. Rotation hooks merged, staging rotate had a single cert rotate lag (resolved). Prod rotation scheduled tonight; I'll run and post results here. Runbook will be added for SRE rollback steps.

Rachel: Embedding cache is live at 10% canary. Early signal: ~22% token cost drop for search-heavy flows, inference latency stable at p99. Need product sign-off on quality checks: want to gate wide rollout on the 2K prompt eval passing fuzz thresholds.

Oliver: Runtime v2 canary at ~35% traffic. Found two things: kv cache TTL too aggressive in few request paths, and a small perf regression at seq_len 4096 under beam search. Coordinating with ML/runtime to land fixes. Likely partial slip for full rollout until fixes land.

Maya: Cost optimizer rules PR in review; blocker: require a labeled A/B prompt set (1k) to validate no regressions. Research, can you provide a 1K balanced subset by tomorrow AM? @Sanjay @Rachel FYI — cost rules depend on cache improvements.

Sanjay: I'll post the runbook link after prod rotation. Also FYI — autoscaler scale tests will need extra cloud quota (vCPU and instance count). @Oliver, please add exact quota numbers to the autoscaler ticket.

Oliver: Added quota request details to ticket #4521 and CI job: ci/autoscaler-stress-nightly. Marked request with justification.

Rachel: I'll assemble the 2K prompt eval subset and spin up baseline runs this afternoon; if the quality delta < 1% we'll expand to 50% canary next week.

DevOps Bot: deploy success — rotation-hook v1.3 deployed to staging at 2026-03-17T21:12:04Z

Maya: Short action summary:
- Oliver: autoscaler patch (init/eviction/backpressure) + e2e stress test. ETA 72h. Reply with test plan link.
- Oliver: runtime v2 fixes (kv TTL + seq4096 perf). ETA 5d for patches + small canary bump plan.
- Sanjay: runprod PKI rotation tonight + publish runbook link.
- Rachel: produce 1K prompt A/B subset and run baseline -> post metrics by EOD.
- Maya: hold cost rules merge until eval; will prepare rollout checklist and monitor.

Oliver: ack. Will post e2e test plan and the CI link once quota bump is confirmed.

Sanjay: ack. Prod rotation scheduled and I'll flag the quota request with cloud infra for expedited approval.

Rachel: ack, starting eval now; will post a short table of metrics + canary increment proposal.

Maya: Thanks. If any ETA slips beyond these windows, reply here and I'll escalate at the weekly leadership sync.

Oliver: FYI there's a dependency on a new quant build from Research for the runtime perf fix. Marked as blocker in ticket. @Maya please ping Research if we don't have a build by EOD.

Maya: Will ping Research EOD if no build. Also scheduling a 15-min huddle tomorrow AM if autoscaler patch could affect live traffic — invite to follow.

Rachel: Quick Q — for embedding cache at 50% do we want auto-fallback on regression or manual rollback? I prefer auto fallback with a metric trigger + alerting.

Oliver: Agree on auto-fallback + alerting. Suggested trigger: >2% top-k quality regression or >5% increase in latency p99 triggers rollback.

Maya: Agreed. Rachel, please add the alert rule + a 1-paragraph rollback runbook snippet; I can proof the wording.

DevOps Bot: deploy triggered — prod-pki-rotation started at 2026-03-17T23:58:12Z

Sanjay: Prod rotation complete, hosts all green. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.internal/pki-rotation-runbook

Maya: Thanks. Please update the tracker statuses after your posts so I can compile a brief for the weekly OKR mail.

Oliver: Tracker updated: Autoscaler = slipped -> patching; Runtime v2 = partial canary; others updated as shipped/canary.

Rachel: Tracker updated: Embedding cache = canary(10%) -> metrics look positive; will expand after eval.

Maya: Good progress. If anyone sees regression overnight, ping #incidents and drop an update here. Will draft the OKR summary once final statuses are in.
